review_status: transcript-informed synthetic seed; human review required before publishing a quality claim
methodology: The cases encode observable dialogue patterns found in public mock-interview transcripts: clarify scope before architecture, turn estimates into design decisions, maintain one scenario, expose trade-offs and failures, and close with validation. Transcript wording is not copied.

topics.label: Functional and non-functional requirements
topics.evidence: The design begins by identifying channels, delivery latency, durability, user preferences, and scale.

topics.label: Asynchronous architecture
topics.evidence: An API accepts requests, durable queues absorb bursts, and channel-specific workers isolate provider behavior.

topics.label: Retries and idempotency
topics.evidence: At-least-once delivery requires idempotency keys, exponential backoff, dead-letter queues, and delivery state.

topics.label: Operational validation
topics.evidence: Measure enqueue latency, end-to-end latency, provider error rates, duplicate rate, and queue age.

inputs.scope_title: Designing an enterprise retrieval-augmented generation platform

topics.label: Scope and access constraints
topics.evidence: Answers require citations and must enforce document access control at retrieval time.

topics.label: Ingestion and serving paths
topics.evidence: Separate asynchronous parsing and indexing from the online retrieval and answer path.

topics.label: Retrieval quality
topics.evidence: Start with lexical retrieval, then add semantic search or reranking only for measured misses.

topics.label: Evaluation and monitoring
topics.evidence: Track retrieval recall, citation correctness, unsupported claims, latency, and cost using reviewed queries.
